desc:
Rally with a Friend! Early access is here!

Team up with a friend and take on narrow roads, blind corners and jumps. One player drives while the copilot calls turns using a handheld map. Hold onto it, or drop it into the cabin.

Explore Finland, Sweden, Utah and Japan, with two stages per country and day or night driving (way more to come 👀). Face fog, rain, snow, dirty windshields and headlights that can cut out. (also a lot more features are planned)

Meet in the pits (hub), form a party and enter your own private stage. Optional passes unlock Japan Touge and more cars, including the Ponda, WRC car and four-seat XRW for up to four players.

Finish clean stages to earn REP, set personal bests and climb the leaderboards. Hard crashes can cause blackouts and cost REP. Solo driving is available with a dashboard map, but solo times are not ranked.

Are you here to mess around with friends or chase the fastest time?

Original Credits to Left! Left! LEFT! on Steam. GO PLAY IT!
